# `irs527_form8871`

**IRS Form 8871 Section 527 notices**

IRS Form 8871 political organization notice of Section 527 status records (record type 1) from PolOrgsFullData.zip, retaining literal dates and ISO-8859-1 text.

**Coverage.** Not a range. All record-type-1 political organization notices (Form 8871) present in the captured IRS Section 527 PolOrgsFullData.zip archive. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `irs527_form8871.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
